description: This file defines a template class VectorBuffer that implements a vector-like buffer with manual memory management, supporting efficient move and destruction operations for trivially copyable and non-trivially destructible types.

classes.name: VectorBuffer
classes.description: A template class providing a vector-like buffer with manual control over memory, supporting move semantics and destruction for different type traits.

methods.name: VectorBuffer()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an empty VectorBuffer.

methods.name: VectorBuffer(size_t count)
methods.description: Constructor that allocates memory for 'count' elements of type T.

methods.name: VectorBuffer(VectorBuffer&& other) noexcept
methods.description: Move constructor that transfers ownership of the buffer from 'other'.

methods.name: operator=(VectorBuffer&& other)
methods.description: Move assignment operator that transfers ownership of the buffer.

methods.name: capacity()
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: begin()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the beginning of the buffer.

methods.name: end()
methods.description: Returns pointer to one past the last element.

methods.name: DestructRange(T* begin, T* end)
methods.description: Destructs objects in the range; optimized for trivially destructible types.

methods.name: MoveRange(T* from_begin, T* from_end, T* to)
methods.description: Moves objects from one range to another, optimized for trivially copyable, move-constructible, or other types.
